info.name: FLOW - Transformation Service Full
info.description:
Complete transformation service: 23 endpoints.

Connection (5) + Source Query (2) + S3 Upload (7) + Hive/Trino (4) +
Ingest/Extract (3) + Schema (2).

Requires: DB config, S3 config (s3_bucket, s3_region, s3_access_key, s3_secret_key,
s3_csv_key, s3_excel_key, s3_pdf_key, s3_csv_url, s3_excel_url, s3_pdf_url),
datasourceId, realmId via environment.
